message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine dated "2-8 MARET 2015". Centered at the top in large red serif font is the word "TEMPO". Above it, smaller black text reads "TERBANG PILIH MENTERI JONAN" and "MENGAPA PDIP MENGGERGAJI AHOK" separated by a diagonal line.

The main headline, "AGAR KPK MATI SURI", is rendered in large, bold black sans-serif font on the left. Below it, smaller text states: "Satu per satu pendukung KPK dilaporkan ke polisi. Pengakuan eksklusif saksi kasus Novel Baswedan."

The background depicts a multi-story white building labeled "KPK" on its side. Thick, dark grey smoke billows from the top of this building, filling the upper right corner. In the foreground, the upper half of a silver car with a blue and white police light bar is visible. Inside the car, two indistinct figures are visible behind the windshield; the one on the right wears a bright yellow vest. At the bottom left, a barcode sits next to the text "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". The entire image is framed by a solid red vertical border on the left.
